learning_outcomes.text: The main objective of this course is to acquire proficiency and capability in the use of spreadsheet tools to implement practical solutions through task automation and data lifecycle management (loading, cleaning, reconciliation, and exploitation using different techniques according to the needs of the problem to be solved).

syllabus_topics: 1.2-Working with cells and sheets, data import and references
Didactic Unit UT2: Building, interpreting, and exploiting data
Didactic Unit UT3: Representing information and automating tasks
3.2-Spreadsheet applications: forms, printing, document generation, and mail merge
teaching_methods: Lectures with IT and audiovisual support

assessment_methods.method: Group practical case study (with partial progress submission)
Weekly 1-minute quiz (3 questions on concepts covered during the week)

assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 5.0 is required in both the Final Practical Case and the Individual Practical Exercise. The course does not have an extraordinary retake opportunity. The ordinary call corresponds to the Continuous Assessment mentioned above. Each enrollment in transversal subjects, as is the case here, will entail a single call.
